upgrade.elementals.mudSurge.description: Sends a wave of mud in the direction you're looking, slowing anyone caught in it.
upgrade.elementals.mudTrap.description: Traces a line of mud toward your target, dragging them underground where they'll suffocate. Hold crouch to keep them trapped.
upgrade.elementals.crystalShard.descript: Fires a spike of crystal in the direction you're looking, dealing damage to whatever it hits.
upgrade.elementals.boneControl.descripti: Conjures a bone spike you can freely steer up/down, side to side, and closer/further with your aim and scroll wheel, then hurl at will.
upgrade.elementals.sandTornado.descripti: Whips up a spinning column of sand where you're aiming, sucking in nearby sand blocks and dragging, blinding, and battering anyone caught inside. Hold crouch to keep it going.
upgrade.elementals.glassShards.descripti: Fires a shard of glass in the direction you're looking, dealing damage to whatever it hits.
upgrade.elementals.lavaPool.description: Melts the ground where you're aiming into a pool of real lava. Cools into basalt after a while.
upgrade.elementals.atmospherePressurePoi: Crushes the ground around the point you're standing on. Anyone caught inside is forced to crawl, and starts taking damage if they linger too long.
upgrade.elementals.atmosphericDome.descr: Surrounds you with a dome of compressed air. Deflects projectiles back at their source, pushes away anything nearby, and shatters light obstructions like leaves and webs. Hold crouch to maintain it.
upgrade.elementals.gasCloud.description: Release a cloud of gas around you, dazing and slowing every living thing caught inside.
upgrade.elementals.gasCloudSizeI.descrip: Increases the radius of Gas Cloud by 0.75 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.gasCloudSizeII.descri: Increases the radius of Gas Cloud by another 0.75 blocks.
upgrade.elementals.gasVentI.description: Reduces the cooldown of Gas Cloud by 1 second.
upgrade.elementals.gasVentII.description: Reduces the cooldown of Gas Cloud by another 1 second.
upgrade.elementals.gasSpecialization.des: Choose a single path for your Gas Cloud: Suffocate, Leak, or Ignite. Only one can be active at a time.
upgrade.elementals.gasSuffocate.descript: Your Gas Cloud instantly damages everyone caught inside it.
upgrade.elementals.gasLeak.description: Your Gas Cloud leaves a lingering cloud behind, slowing and dazing anyone who walks through it.
upgrade.elementals.gasLeakDurationI.desc: Increases the duration of the lingering cloud by 5 seconds.
upgrade.elementals.gasIgnite.description: Ignites your Gas Cloud, causing an instant explosion centered on you. High risk, high reward.
